scope: One original-native fitted-plane duplicate and separate application GUI/public-MCP duplicate on the same PLY file; not full M4 acceptance.

native.operation: Plane(1) history menu Duplicate created Plane(1)(1) and Planes(2).
native.beforeSave: Original and duplicate showed the same displayed normal and offset in Type In mode.
native.reopen: Both history items reopened; the duplicate editor retained those displayed values.
native.cleanup: Authenticated owned finish, zero active processes, closed handles, no cleanup errors, released mutex; 100.06 seconds under 540-second outer lease.

displayDirectionComparison.scope: Same input PLY, native displayed decimals versus the existing application/public MCP fit receipt; native selection and sampling membership are unknown.
displayDirectionComparison.limitations: The angle uses rounded native UI text and ignores axis sign. Native fit membership, weighting, residual and plane equation convention are not established; this is not a matched-fit parity claim. Candidate matching 64-bit values in both saved records are not identified as authoritative fields without serializer evidence.

storedReadback.scope: Strict, data-only index and bounded field comparison of the two pinned QSF v4 files; no native execution or reference-point/line copy-policy claim.
storedReadback.observation: The four original record spans are byte-identical after duplication; a fifth type-0x8 record is appended. The two type-0x8 records contain the observed Plane(1) and Plane(1)(1) strings and each repeats a different 16-byte value in two positions. Excluding those two 16-byte fields and string count/value leaves 304 compared bytes, with one differing byte at normalized offset 4. Its four-byte little-endian values are 4 and 5, matching these records' one-based positions; that field's meaning is not established.
storedReadback.verifiedPrefix: A byte-verified 958-byte serializer entry writes the type-0x8 marker, 120-byte header, existing name/common-state helpers and a selected plane prefix. Reading that prefix finds distinct identities, empty saved common source/dependent sets, update level 0 and raw mode 2 in both records. The next vector and scalar fields contain promoted FLT_MAX sentinels and the 12-byte record count is zero in both. This one case does not establish behavior after source edits, other plane modes or reference-point/line duplication.
storedReadback.candidatePayload: The captured type-8 loader branch, constructor table assignment and serializer slot lead statically to a byte-verified 112-byte payload writer; the live table binding was not observed. Both records contain identical 112-byte payloads at the expected position. The first stored vector is [0.44967119665687344, -0.3367553132527314, -0.82727968299314], matching the native displayed normal at its shown precision. Two additional vectors and two scalars are recorded in the private readback without assigning geometric roles. In this zero-list case, the remaining 32 bytes are all zero in both records and the read consumes each record through its end. Their meanings and general tail and copy-link behavior are not established.
storedReadback.initialOffsetAttempt: A first exploratory read used the point/line name offset and returned empty strings; that interpretation was rejected and its receipt retained. The corrected bounded read uses the next field and matches the independently observed native names.

applicationAndMcp.coverage: Actual GUI menu Duplicate and public stdio MCP object_duplicate produced distinct identities and equal fit/frame to the original and each other; GUI undo and MCP-created copy project-worker reopen and undo passed.
applicationAndMcp.cleanup: Private ephemeral ports closed, owned processes exited and mutex released; 23.28 seconds under 480-second outer lease.

limitations: The same input file does not establish matching native and application fit populations, weighting, residuals or frame conventions; no fit equivalence is claimed.

Native displayed decimals alone are not raw binary values. A saved-vector candidate matches the display, but its live writer binding and geometric role are not proven. No source edits were tested; original plane properties were not reread after reopen.
The native case concerns a fitted plane, not semantic reference point or line duplication. Native undo, locks, transforms and other modes remain open.
This checkpoint does not complete M4 or authorize merge or milestone closure.
